subject.title: Dashboard: widget publish + community registry — the ecosystem half of the gallery

question: Should dashboard widget publishing and registry browsing be owned as a bundled OpenClaw dashboard feature, routed through ClawHub/package distribution, or left as an external experiment until the base dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The issue defines a new distribution and trust surface for untrusted dashboard code, and automation cannot choose the product boundary or registry trust model safely.

options.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
options.body: Keep the issue open and require widget publish/browse/install to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus the dashboard approval gate after prerequisites land.

options.title: External Experiment First
options.body: Ask contributors to prototype publishing as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers sponsor a bundled dashboard distribution surface.

options.title: Pause Widget Registry Direction
options.body: Close or defer this direction if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own a dashboard widget ecosystem surface now.

recommendation.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require widget publish/browse/install to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus the dashboard approval gate after prerequisites land.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history ties Vincent Koc to the plugin-tab seam and VISION/plugin distribution guardrails that decide this boundary.
